status_verified_desc: Application reviewed and compliant with AuxiNux criteria.
status_compatible_desc: Generally acceptable application, with documented reservations.
status_unreviewed_desc: Application not yet reviewed by AuxiNux.
scripts_warning: This package contains custom scripts: running them requires explicit authorization.
values_intro: The official AuxiPak catalog favors applications that respect the following values. Reviews are performed by the AuxiNux team; they are separate from cryptographic signatures, which only attest a package's origin and integrity.
value_4: Priority to free software, without systematically excluding proprietary software.
values_rule: A publisher can never grant itself the “Verified” status: classification belongs exclusively to the AuxiPak server and its administration. External repositories cannot carry official certification.
docs_client_text: The “auxipak” client is available for Linux (Debian, Ubuntu, AuxiNuxOS, VirtuaOS), Windows and macOS. It verifies index authenticity (TUF) and each package signature before any installation.
docs_repo: Add this server as a repository
docs_repo_text: The official repository is preconfigured. For an external repository, obtain its root.json through a secure channel, then:
docs_more: The complete documentation is in the project repository (docs/).
login_throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
signing_key_missing: Missing: only pre-signed packages can be published.
approved_msg: Submission approved: the package is published and the index regenerated.
upload_help: The file creates a submission. It is only published after a reviewer approves it.
revoke_confirm: Revocation is permanent and marks the package as dangerous for clients. A reason is required.
name: Name
title: Title
token_kind_help: “agent” (automation, AI) and “ci” can never approve, classify or administer.
new_token: New token — copy it now, it will not be shown again:
footer: AuxiPak — application distribution service for the AuxiNux ecosystem
purge_confirm: Delete the files of this or these revoked release(s)? Clients will keep refusing them.
purge_help: Deleted releases disappear from this list but stay in the revocation list: clients keep refusing them.
cleanup_submissions_help: Invalid, rejected, failed or already published submissions (the published release keeps its own copy). Pending submissions are never deleted.
